''See also: [[Kthanikahr Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Kthanikahr, also known as the [[Worm Lord]], is a [[Great Elder]] characterized by themes of decay and the impermanence of physical flesh. This entity possesses a massive, miles-long worm body that has been observed partially exposed while burrowing near a mountain. Legend suggests that Kthanikahr digests its victims alive over the course of a millennium. The entity's primary interest lies in preserving the planet as a suitable habitat for its worms, often seeking to replace humanity with them. Kthanikahr's influence is manifested through various forces, including [[giant worms]] and specialized spawn that can swarm enemies like mobile nests of tentacles. Historical accounts link the entity to the creation of the [[Dylian Basin]] through a legendary battle with a powerful [[Soulbound]] warrior. While some believe Kthanikahr's tomb is located in northern [[Izyria]], the entity's movements and activities remain difficult to track, leaving its current status uncertain.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Kthanikahr]] is interested in preserving the planet as a habitat for his worms.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c28" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Of Dawn and Darkness}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The worms of Kthanikahr represent a possible [[Fate|fate]] for individuals demoted from the leadership of the [[Sleepless]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c13">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 13</ref> Known as the [[Worm Lord]], Kthanikahr is a monster appearing as a miles-long worm burrowed around a towering mountain.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 16</ref> According to myth, this creature digests its victims alive over the course of a thousand years.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">3</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The worms of [[Kthanikahr]] are a potential [[Fate|fate]] for those demoted from [[Sleepless]] leadership.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c13" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Kthanikahr]] is the [[Worm Lord]] and a monster that can be seen as a miles-long worm burrowed around a towering mountain.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Myth states that [[Kthanikahr]] digests his victims alive over a thousand years.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Of Kings and Killers}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Kthanikahr is an unknown entity described as a man with worms emerging from his skin.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 23</ref> Often referred to as a grave-bug, he possesses spawn that consist of the very worms protruding from him.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref> This spawn is capable of tying a person as if they were bound by hundreds of ropes.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Kthanikahr]] is referred to as a grave-bug.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The worms were the spawn of [[Kthanikahr]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
